content:
Nora (PM): small spike: should saved views include a tiny "health" column showing if telemetry coverage for that (route,model) is reliable? low-traffic combos are noisy and folks misinterpret.
Dev - Eng: yes. propose fields: coverage (high/medium/low), sample_rate (float), last_agg_ts. low means sample_rate < 0.01 or last_agg_ts > 48h.
Kai - Design: health icon: green/yellow/red with hover text. show sample_rate in tooltip. prefer short strings.
Marta - Data: computing coverage: use inverse-variance of bootstrap on latency + effective_sample_size. will expose a normalized score -> map to high/med/low. note: models behind A/B experiments can skew routing_mix. add a flag "exp_bucketed" when experiments exist.
Priya - Platform: if health is low we should disable quota-estimate and show "insufficient data". also the UI should offer a "force re-eval" button that triggers an on-demand job (rate-limited).
Nora (PM): sounds good. add to spec: health column + force-re-eval endpoint + CI numbers. I'll add to the FF plan.
